[quote]These 2 can be done normally in 4v4 but it will take a long time.

I'd suggest doing what I did and get 1 or 3 friends to queue for 1v1 or 2v2 slayer. (VPN to a lower player count country can help you get matched against each other. Australia worked for me.)

Aim for the map Lockdown and take turns getting the coils and ice. You can get splatters from the ice if the person getting killed gets hit directly in the head while looking at the ice. This way you get a splatter and environmental kill at the same time. Might take a few attempts to figure out the right spot and positioning but once you figure it out you will get them pretty consistently.

Focus the ice whenever it is up as you can use the coils for the environmental's but not the splatters.

If you don't get lockdown (which happens a lot) just go for other achievements on the other maps like backstabs or grenade kills, whatever you need.

If you need people for this achievement try putting a post in the Steam Discussions. A few people will probably be looking to do something similar.

Good Luck![/quote]

[quote]Make sure you play the LASO playlist. Don't just start each mission with all skulls on. Otherwise you won't get the achievement! You can get to the playlist as shown below.

MCC Main Menu > Campaign > Halo 4 > Playlists > LASO Campaign

- Play it slow in certain areas, don't feel pressured to rush through an area.
- Backstab Elites when possible.
- Try and headshot the grunts or backstab if they are running.
- Enemies aim for your body so leaving only your head visible allows you to shoot while in cover
‏‏‎ ‎‏‏‎ ‎allowing the cover to tank the enemy's bullets.

[u]H3: ODST: Complete a Halo 3: ODST LASO Campaign playlist.[/u]


[quote]Make sure you play the LASO playlist. Don't just start each mission with all skulls on. Otherwise you won't get the achievement! You can get to the playlist as shown below.

MCC Main Menu > Campaign > Halo 3: ODST > Playlists > LASO Campaign (You can do either LASO but I'd do the shorter one so it isn't as hard.)

- Range shoot brutes. They have a short line of site so if you can sit far enough back they won't detect you while you charge a plasma pistol and use a BR or Carbine to get a headshot. Meaning they won't dodge your first attack.
- Similar to the range shooting method you can try pop shooting when in short distance. Charge a plasma pistol and quickly peak and shoot and get back in cover. They won't detect you meaning they won't dodge the shot.
- Shielded Jackals sometimes after charging the plasma pistol to long cause it to dissipate and renders the weapon unusable. Allowing you to easily walk up and melee jackals for a free shield.
- If a brute starts berserking aim to kill it immediately. Easiest methods are plasma, spike or fire bomb grenades. Alternatively go for headshots when possible.
- Carbine and Beam rifles are much better when fighting brutes. It takes less shots to drop there armour.
- Try and use some speed run tactics if you can in certain areas. It might allow you to get through without fighting anyone.
- Try and use allied AI to get the attention of the enemy allowing you to run through certain areas.
- Give other ODST's (Invincible Characters/Main Characters) Heavy Weapons like Fuel Rods, Spartan Lasers or Rockets. This will allow them to tank the damage while also being able to kill hard enemies for you.
- Finally go for backstabs when ever you can. It will help and save ammo and get your health back. Remember Plasma Pistol and the normal pistol are your best friend.[/quote]

MCC Main Menu > Campaign > Halo 3 > Playlists > LASO Campaign

- Range shoot brutes. They have a short line of site so if you can sit far enough back they won't detect you while you charge a plasma pistol and use a BR or Carbine to get a headshot. Meaning they won't dodge your first attack.
- Similar to the range shooting method you can try pop shooting when in short distance. Charge a plasma pistol and quickly peak and shoot and get back in cover. They won't detect you meaning they won't dodge the shot.
-  Shielded Jackals sometimes after charging the plasma pistol to long cause it to dissipate and renders the weapon unusable. Allowing you to easily walk up and melee jackals for a free shield.
- If a brute starts berserking aim to kill it immediately. Easiest methods are plasma, spike or fire bomb grenades. Alternatively go for headshots when possible. 
- Carbine and Beam rifles are much better when fighting brutes. It takes less shots to drop there armour. 
- Try and use some speed run tactics if you can in certain areas. It might allow you to get through without fighting anyone. 
- Try and use allied AI to get the attention of the enemy allowing you to run through certain areas.
- Finally go for backstabs when ever you can. It will help and save ammo.[/quote]

[u]Halo CE: Complete the Halo: CE LASO Campaign playlist.[/u]


[quote]Make sure you play the LASO playlist. Don't just start each mission with all skulls on. Otherwise you won't get the achievement! You can get to the playlist as shown below.

MCC Main Menu > Campaign > Halo: CE Anniversary > Playlists > LASO Campaign

Tips:
- Be aware of the huge explosion range and dead grunts. Always try and keep your distance.
- Play it slow in certain areas, don't feel pressured to rush through an area.
- Backstab Elites or hope the grunts explosions drop the shields and go for a headshot.
- Try and headshot the grunts so they blow up the rest of the enemies.
- Enemies aim for your body so leaving only your head visible allows you to shoot while in cover
‏‏‎ ‎‏‏‎ ‎allowing the cover to tank the enemy's bullets.
- Always pickup overshield's or active camo to get through areas much easier.
- Watch out for marines throwing "suicide grenades". Believe me it's a pain.
- Try and use allied AI to get the attention of the enemy allowing you to run through certain areas.
- Learn how to do the [url=https://youtu.be/_DHm2B_BBRQ]Infinite Ammo glitch[/url]. Helps a lot on the harder missions. (Double tap r to reload and swap weapons on the floor, leave it for a few seconds and if you pick it back up it will have a full clip without using any ammo.) [/quote]

- Play it slow in certain areas, don't feel pressured to rush through an area.

[quote]Sigil Dates:
January 1st (New Year's Day): Make Love Not War
April 22nd (Earth Day): A skull with a recycling sign
May 5th (Cinco De Mayo): Toady Was Live!
July 4th (Independence Day): BBQ at Bob's
October 31st (Halloween): A grave stone that has the initials "R.I.P."
November 11th (Veteran's Day): Kilroy Was Here
December 25th (Christmas): A Christmas light with an “X” marked through it

On one of these days, in your local timezone, you will need to load a custom game in Halo 3 on Valhalla, and then go to the giant metal wall/structure in the middle and side of the map. Then head to the graffiti and look at it. On the dates listed above, the sign will be unique and the achievement will unlock. I'd add one of these dates to your calendar. [/quote]
